files.actual_content: A woman holds a Nutella jar, unscrews and lifts its lid, then smells the open jar; no spoon or eating action is visible.
The same woman holds the same front-facing Nutella jar while changing television light colors move over her face and clothing.

same_session_evidence: Both files show the same woman, gray top, centered jar, camera height, dark television environment, and changing blue-green screen light.
The jar geometry, lid, label, hand placement, and product scale match; the Nutella wordmark remains readable.
Adjacent asset IDs and the same creator support, but do not replace, the direct visual identity check.
decision: Use only to test action-to-sensory-response-to-readable-brand-recovery ordering. Do not claim that it proves a hidden-product reveal, spoon use, eating, or endorsement.
